messages:
raj: quick heads-up — access-review ran and found a weird interleaving on admin-role 'infra-admin' — two owners show up in the owner field and KMS audit has grant events after owner removal. anyone seen this?

maria: ugh. can you paste the KMS log snippet? possible delayed propagation or a retained grant.

raj: pasted below:
```
2024-05-14T13:02:11Z KMS GrantCreate GrantId=g-abc123 Principal=svc-deployer
2024-05-14T13:10:05Z IAM RemoveRoleBinding role=infra-admin member=user:olivia@example.com
2024-05-14T13:12:30Z KMS Use Decrypt KeyId=key-xyz Principal=user:olivia@example.com
```

maria: interesting — RemoveRoleBinding at 13:10 but decrypt at 13:12 by same user. suggests either stale grants or session tokens not revoked.

audit-bot: automated alert: policy-drift-detection triggered for infra-admin. evidence bundle attached -> /internal/audit/1748254321

olivia: i was doing a canary deploy then removed my binding. i didn't use the key after 13:10. could be deploy pipeline using svc-deployer which assumes my identity (token exchange?).

tyler: check for AWS STS AssumeRole sessions or federation. run:
```
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name olivia
aws sts get-session-token --duration-seconds 3600
aws kms list-grants --key-id key-xyz
```

maria: +1. also run our telemetry query to map session id -> principal: `SELECT session, principal FROM auth.events WHERE key_id='key-xyz' AND ts>'2024-05-14'`

sam (oncall): assigned INC-2349 to triage. Please collect: grant + revoke timestamps, session tokens, deploy pipeline run id, and snapshot of role bindings. tagging @infra-oncall.

raj: filing compliance packet for quarterly review. action items: (1) rotate key-xyz if grants can't be accounted for, (2) add immediate revoke hook in pipeline, (3) audit script to detect grant after role removal. i'll update INC-2349.

olivia: noted — i'll block the pipeline run candidate and re-run with explicit principal. ping me in INC when ready.

maria: we should add a regression test to access-review job to catch grants that outlive bindings. i'll open a PR with a check and link it to the incident.

raj: thanks all. i'll post postmortem outline in #postmortems once we close the incident. :white_check_mark:
